name: VeoVideo
title: Gemini Video
description: Generate short videos with Google Gemini Omni, from a prompt, a first frame and a last frame
whenToUse: Turn still images and a description into a short video with sound, four to eight seconds. Give it the frame to open on and, optionally, the frame to end on, and it animates the transition between them; up to three reference images keep a character or product looking the same. A still image, and a live spoken conversation, are different jobs.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: Data from previous nodes, referenceable in the prompt and image urls

outputs.name: video
outputs.description: The finished video: dataUri, mimeType, fileName, bytes

model.title: Model
model.description: Which Gemini model to render with

prompt.title: Motion Prompt
prompt.description: What happens in the video, the motion, camera, mood and sound.

firstFrameUrl.title: First Frame URL
firstFrameUrl.description: The image the video opens on. Leave empty to generate from the prompt alone.

lastFrameUrl.title: Last Frame URL
lastFrameUrl.description: The image the video ends on. Needs a first frame. Leave empty to let the model decide.

referenceImageUrls.title: Reference Image URLs
referenceImageUrls.description: Up to three images, one URL per line, of a character or product to keep looking the same.

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: The length asked for in the prompt. The model aims for it.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: 720p is the default; 1080p and 4k are upscaled.

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: google-gemini
package.packageFile:
# GEMINI IMAGE GENERATION AS A MANIFEST. Needed nothing new: an api-key header, a JSON POST,
# and `transport: binary` for the optional reference photo, which S3Upload had already forced.
#
# TWO THINGS CHANGED, both recorded on the node itself:
#
#   the instruction text  The retired service held two long instruction strings inline. They
#                         are prompt BLOCKS now, because a node holding a copy of words that
#                         also live in a block is a copy that drifts.
#   generateContent       The retired service used the SDK's generateContentStream and
#                         accumulated the chunks. This asks the non-streaming endpoint for the
#                         same thing, so the node still settles once and stays a PromiseNode.
#
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/gce-toolkit/`.

name: google-gemini
displayName: Google Gemini
description: Generate images and videos with Google Gemini
version: 2.1.0
category: media
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1768126954/gravity/icons/gemini.png

features:
  - Text to image, several images per request
  - An optional reference photo, used for facial likeness only
  - The model's own text response alongside the images
  - Short videos with sound from Gemini Omni, from a first frame, a last frame and reference images

allowedHosts:
  - generativelanguage.googleapis.com
  # Any host, for the UNAUTHENTICATED image fetches only (reference photo, video frames). The url is one a person
  # supplies, so it cannot be declared in advance. That call sends no credential, and the
  # executor refuses "*" the moment one does.
  - "*"

requires:
  credential: [apiKeyHeader]
  transport: [json, binary]
  executorVersion: ">=1.6.0"

credentials.geminiCredential.yaml:
# Transcribed from the retired GeminiCredential, NAME AND FIELD UNCHANGED so credentials
# already stored against `geminiCredential` keep resolving.

name: geminiCredential
displayName: Google Gemini
description: Credentials for the Google Gemini API
documentationUrl: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-key

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your Google Gemini API key
    placeholder: AIza...

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output connector, in interface.yaml order.

- emit: video
  from: response
  value: >-
    return ((part) => ({
      dataUri: 'data:' + (part.mime_type || 'video/mp4') + ';base64,' + (part.data || ''),
      mimeType: part.mime_type || 'video/mp4',
      fileName: 'gemini_video.mp4',
      bytes: Math.floor(String(part.data || '').length * 3 / 4)
    }))(((calls.generate || {}).steps || []).filter(s => s.type === 'model_output')
      .reduce((all, s) => all.concat(s.content || []), [])
      .filter(c => c.type === 'video' && c.data)[0] || {})

# `generatedAt` is epoch milliseconds: the sandbox exposes Date.now() and refuses `new`.
# `durationSeconds` is the length asked for: Omni takes length in the prompt and reports none.
- emit: metadata
  from: response
  value: >-
    return {
      model: (calls.generate || {}).model || config.model,
      durationSeconds: Number(config.durationSeconds || 8),
      generatedAt: Date.now()
    }
files.api/run.yaml:
# Fetch the frames (when given), then render and take the file from the reply.
#
# The image fetches carry NO credential, which is why "*" is allowed for them in the package:
# the urls are ones a person supplies. Unlike the image node's reference photo they ARE fatal
# when they fail, because a video told to open on a frame it never received is not the video
# that was asked for.

- name: first
  when: "return !!String(config.firstFrameUrl || '').trim()"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.firstFrameUrl).trim()"
  # { base64, contentType, bytes }, sent on as an image item in the request's `input`.
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

- name: last
  when: "return !!String(config.lastFrameUrl || '').trim()"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.lastFrameUrl).trim()"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

# Up to three references, one url per line. Three named calls rather than a loop: the vendor
# caps it at three, so the ceiling is the API's, not a guess.
- name: ref1
  when: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls || '').split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).length > 0"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls).split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0]"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

- name: ref2
  when: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls || '').split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).length > 1"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls).split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[1]"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

- name: ref3
  when: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls || '').split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).length > 2"
  method: GET
  url: "return String(config.referenceImageUrls).split('\\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[2]"
  transport: binary
  timeoutMs: 60000

# ONE RENDER, answered in one reply through the Interactions API (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/omni).
# The Veo 3.1 preview models this node first called shut down on 2026-10-22, and Google names
# gemini-omni-1.1-flash as their replacement. A workflow saved with a Veo id runs on it too.
# Images come first in `input`: two images with no task are the first and last frames. Omni has no
# duration field; length is asked for in the prompt. The video comes back inline as base64.
- name: generate
  method: POST
  url: "return 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions'"
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyHeader
    header: x-goog-api-key
    value: "{{ credentials.geminiCredential.apiKey }}"
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  transport: json
  timeoutMs: 600000
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]

  body:
    model: "return String(config.model || '').startsWith('gemini-omni') ? config.model : 'gemini-omni-1.1-flash'"
    input: >-
      return [calls.first, calls.last, calls.ref1, calls.ref2, calls.ref3].filter(Boolean)
        .map(i => ({ type: 'image', data: i.base64, mime_type: i.contentType || 'image/png' }))
        .concat([{ type: 'text', text: String(config.prompt || '') + ' The video lasts ' + Number(config.durationSeconds || 8) + ' seconds.' }])
    response_format: "return { type: 'video', aspect_ratio: config.aspectRatio || '16:9', resolution: config.resolution || '720p' }"
    generation_config: "return calls.ref1 ? { video_config: { task: 'reference_to_video' } } : {}"
    background: "return false"
    store: "return false"
    stream: "return false"

  # A render the safety filters removed answers with no video part, and says why in the reply.
  error:
    when: >-
      return !(response.steps || []).filter(s => s.type === 'model_output')
        .reduce((all, s) => all.concat(s.content || []), [])
        .filter(c => c.type === 'video' && c.data).length
    message: "return 'Gemini Omni returned no video. ' + JSON.stringify(response).slice(0, 1000)"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [model, prompt]
  properties:
    model:
      type: string
      title: Model
      description: Which Gemini model to render with
      enum:
        - gemini-omni-1.1-flash
      enumNames:
        - Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
      default: gemini-omni-1.1-flash
    prompt:
      type: string
      title: Motion Prompt
      description: What happens in the video, the motion, camera, mood and sound.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
      "ui:ai":
        editable: true
    firstFrameUrl:
      type: string
      title: First Frame URL
      description: The image the video opens on. Leave empty to generate from the prompt alone.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    lastFrameUrl:
      type: string
      title: Last Frame URL
      description: The image the video ends on. Needs a first frame. Leave empty to let the model decide.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    referenceImageUrls:
      type: string
      title: Reference Image URLs
      description: >-
        Up to three images, one URL per line, of a character or product to keep looking the
        same.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    durationSeconds:
      type: string
      title: Duration (seconds)
      description: The length asked for in the prompt. The model aims for it.
      enum: ["4", "6", "8"]
      default: "8"
    aspectRatio:
      type: string
      title: Aspect Ratio
      enum: ["16:9", "9:16"]
      default: "16:9"
    resolution:
      type: string
      title: Resolution
      description: 720p is the default; 1080p and 4k are upscaled.
      enum: [720p, 1080p, 4k]
      default: 720p
"ui:order": [model, prompt, firstFrameUrl, lastFrameUrl, referenceImageUrls, durationSeconds, aspectRatio, resolution]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: signal
    type: object
    description: Data from previous nodes, referenceable in the prompt and image urls
    required: false

outputs:
  # The file itself, as a data URI a storage step can take directly. Veo's own link needs the
  # API key to download, so it is useless to anything downstream and is not emitted.
  - name: video
    type: object
    description: "The finished video: dataUri, mimeType, fileName, bytes"
  - name: metadata
    type: object
    description: model, durationSeconds, generatedAt

credentials:
  - name: geminiCredential
    required: true
    displayName: Google Gemini API
files.node.yaml:
type: VeoVideo
# The type keeps its first name so saved workflows still resolve; it renders on Gemini Omni now,
# since Google shut down the Veo 3.1 preview models on 2026-10-22. One call, one settled reply.
kind: PromiseNode

name: Gemini Video
category: Media & Design
color: "#4285F4"

description: Generate short videos with Google Gemini Omni, from a prompt, a first frame and a last frame

whenToUse: >-
  Turn still images and a description into a short video with sound, four to eight seconds.
  Give it the frame to open on and, optionally, the frame to end on, and it animates the
  transition between them; up to three reference images keep a character or product looking
  the same. A still image, and a live spoken conversation, are different jobs.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (who-can-run-it.md). Compulsory on every node.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # NOT cacheable: generation is non-deterministic, two runs are meant to differ.
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
# Text-to-video, short and at the lowest resolution offered: the cheapest honest render.
# Asserts the SHAPE: real video bytes came back, never anything about the scene.

testData:
  config:
    model: gemini-omni-1.1-flash
    prompt: >-
      A paper boat drifting across a puddle in light rain, gentle ripples, soft ambient
      sound, slow push-in
    firstFrameUrl: ""
    lastFrameUrl: ""
    referenceImageUrls: ""
    durationSeconds: "4"
    aspectRatio: "16:9"
    resolution: 720p
  inputs:
    signal: {}
  expect:
    video: >-
      return output.video.dataUri.startsWith('data:video/')
        && output.video.bytes > 10000
    metadata: "return output.metadata.generatedAt > 0"
